title: Mrs. A.P. Chernovaloff - Antecedents And Activites

page_data.en:
SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY No. File Not 1 (C) Date October 17, 1940）
Subject Mrs A.P. Chernovaloff - antecedents and activities.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford.

Enquiries show that a Russian female named Alla Petrovna CHERNOVALOFF nee Mahaboff is residing at 49 Wha Kee Avenue where she occupies Room No. 10. She was born on 23-5-1911 at Nagasaki, Japan, and is the daughter of Mr. and Mrs P.S. Mahaboff who arrived in Shanghai from the North some time in 1920 or 1921. Styling himself an ex-Lieut.-Colonel of the Russian army Mahaboff soon came to the notice of the Municipal Police as a fraud and adventurer in connection with his activities as a partner in the "Oriental Engineering Co" and also in connection with certain financial claims and grievances he appeared to have against Ataman Semenoff. On 3-8-1923 he was sentenced by the old Mixed Court to 3 months imprisonment on a charge of Cheating and Fraud. His wife was dead by that time and therefore his daughter Alla was placed in the Foreign Women's Cottage Home, Baikal Road. However, her conduct was such that she was told to leave the place. Later she was found living in a house in company with certain Italian and Russian males and females who were connected with arms and narcotic smuggling, and who were quite friendly with Mahaboff. Apparently, Miss Mahaboff's education left very much to be desired, for in police reports of that time she was described as a girl leading a loose life. While in gaol her father applied to the police authorities with a request to place the girl in a reformatory and referred to her in equally unflattering terms. 事由 A.P. 切尔诺瓦洛夫夫人——身世及活动。
制作人：侦探副督察 普罗科菲耶夫。转呈人：侦探督察 克劳福德。

经查，一名名为阿拉·彼得罗芙娜·切尔诺瓦洛夫（婚前姓马哈博夫）的俄国女子现居住于华琪路49号，占用10号房间。她于1911年5月23日出生于日本长崎，系P.S.马哈博夫夫妇之女，其父母于1920或1921年间某时从北方抵达上海。马哈博夫自称是前俄国陆军中校，很快便因其作为“东方工程公司”合伙人的活动，以及针对阿塔曼谢苗诺夫所提出的某些财务索赔和不满，以骗子和冒险家的身份引起了工部局警务处的注意。1923年8月3日，他因诈骗和欺诈罪被老混合法庭判处监禁三个月。当时其妻已故，因此其女阿拉被安置在贝加尔路的外国妇女收容所。然而，由于她的行为不端，被告知离开该处。后来发现她与某些从事军火和毒品走私、且与马哈博夫关系密切的意大利及俄国男女同住在一所房子里。显然，马哈博夫小姐的教育状况很不理想，因为当时的警方报告中将她描述为一个生活放荡的女孩。在其父服刑期间，他曾向警方当局申请将该女孩送入感化院，并以同样不光彩的措辞提及她。1926年某时，马哈博夫离开上海前往

According to a registration form filled in by
Miss Nahaboff at the Russian Migrants Committee in 1932,
she had at that time relatives in Dairen. In 1934 she re-
sided at 637 Avenue Joffre, House 9. On 16-7-35 she ar-
rived at 268 Range Road coming from Chefoo. It appears
that at that time she worked as a professional dancing
partner.
On 16-2-36 she married a Russian named M.F. Cher-
novaloff ( born on 16-4-1910 at Odessa ) who is reported
to have arrived in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. via Har-
bin in 1932 and from 1-4-32 to 1-5-37 served in the
Russian Regiment, S.V.C. It appears that Mrs Chernova-
loff either continued to work as a dancing partner or
resumed her former occupation soon after her husband's
discharge from the Russian Regiment. In 1939 she is
known to have worked in this capacity in the Moon Palace,
601 East Broadway and to have for various periods resid-
ed at 46 Broadway, 50/8 Ward Road and 161 Muirhead Road.
On 1-2-40 she went to live at 49 Wha Kee Avenue and work-
ed as a dancing partner in the Majestic Cafe for a pe-
riod, after which she is reported to have been "kept" by
a foreigner, name and nationality unknown. Together with
her lived another Russian female named Nina Sheltrop,
20, also a dancing partner, who was believed to be Mrs
Chernovalova's relation and who committed suicide on 31-3-40.

根据纳哈博夫小姐1932年在俄国移民委员会填写的登记表，她当时在大连有亲属。1934年，她居住在霞飞路637号9室。1935年7月16日，她从烟台抵达兰路268号。看来当时她以职业舞伴为业。
1936年2月16日，她与一名名为M.F.切尔诺瓦洛夫的俄国人结婚（1910年4月16日出生于敖德萨），据报此人于1932年经哈尔滨从苏联抵达上海，并于1932年4月1日至1937年5月1日期间在俄国团（上海义勇队）服役。看来切尔诺瓦洛夫夫人在其丈夫从俄国团退役后，要么继续担任舞伴，要么很快重操旧业。已知1939年她在百老汇路601号的月宫舞厅以此身份工作，并曾断续居住在百老汇路46号、华德路50/8号和穆尔黑德路161号。1940年2月1日，她搬至华琪路49号居住，并在玛杰斯提克咖啡馆担任了一段时间的舞伴，此后据报被一名外国人“包养”，姓名及国籍不详。与她同住的还有另一名名为尼娜·谢尔特罗普的20岁俄国女子，也是一名舞伴，据信是切尔诺瓦洛夫夫人的亲属，她于1940年3月31日自杀身亡。

华琪路49号是一所持牌寄宿公寓，业主为一名名为F.格林什蓬的俄国犹太妇女。在该公寓的住客中，可以找到各种各样的人——中国人、朝鲜人、日本人、俄国人、德国难民以及其他外国人，包括美国海军成员。

切尔诺瓦洛夫小姐在上海期间，并未因任何不良活动引起工部局警务处的注意，调查也未获取任何可能表明她与任何政治活动有关联的信息。
